analysis.note: Jabbit analysis. Six randomized human tests of GLP-1-type drugs on drinking have reported (exenatide 2022 missed its main goal; dulaglutide 2023 secondary analysis; semaglutide 2025 lab study; semaglutide 2026 Lancet in AUD plus obesity met; oral semaglutide 2026 missed its craving goal but cut heavy drinking days; pemvidutide 2026 company topline met). All were small (48 to 151 people) and 8 to 26 weeks. Observational studies consistently link these drugs to fewer alcohol-related hospital visits, but cannot prove cause, and one found the drinking change shrank after accounting for weight loss. No GLP-1 drug is approved for alcohol use disorder; Lilly's two 1,100-person brenipatide phase 3 trials and a 622-person VA semaglutide trial are the first large tests. The Heineken warning is a business forecast reported by The Guardian citing Reuters, not evidence about health.
